rulesTestNames: lets a guest get and list only their own contact permissions
owner: messaging contact permission writer, called in the same transaction by every consent writer
read: the guest gets and lists only their own documents by path while their account is not deleted; no organiser reads them directly, organisers get counts and audiences through the server's senderId + granted collection-group query
write: server only; rewritten from the Catch or organiser preference in the transaction that changes it, deleted at account deletion
migrationNotes: Issue #2460 phase 1. One document per sender and person replaces the channel-wide and per-purpose layers of catchCommunicationPreferences and organizerCommunicationPreferences: each channel:purpose answer is the effective status today's send gates compute, written explicitly.
The contact-permissions migration in tool/data/migrate_firestore_consolidation.mjs converts preferences recorded before the transactional writers.
